candidate_realization_protocol.selection_rule: first prospective realization under the declared protocol; no discrepancy-based realization selection

U1.name: reference_update_aligned_shift

U1.claim: relative acceleration or attenuation along the baseline update; not harm

U2.name: coordinate_frame_mean_update_field
U2.claim: fixed-coordinate average update shift; norm is magnitude, not directional training bias

T1a.name: heldout_grpo_surrogate_shift

sampling.source: training-consistent explicit GRPOConfig values; model generation_config defaults are not inherited

evaluation_bank.prompt_encoding: raw non-conversational tokenizer(text=prompt), add_special_tokens tokenizer default, left padding for generation
evaluation_bank.old_logprob_source: common eager FP16 SDPA-math scorer on the frozen pre-step reference state
evaluation_bank.advantage_source: forkcert numeric reward, then float32 per-prompt sample standard deviation (Bessel correction) normalization across four completions with denominator std+1e-4
evaluation_bank.all_tied_rule: retain tied groups with zero advantages; if every group is tied, mark T1a UNINSTANTIATED for that state and do not resample for signal
evaluation_bank.weighting: equal prompt; equal valid completion token within prompt

T1a.post_state_evaluator: same common eager FP16 SDPA-math realization for both next states

T1b.name: heldout_correct_answer_nll_shift

evaluation_bank.artifact_identity: tokenizer and encoded prompt/completion hashes recorded before collection

T1b.post_state_evaluator: same common eager FP16 SDPA-math realization for both next states

randomness.t1a_bank_role: one frozen state-derived bank shared by every arm/repeat; bank reconstruction mismatch is evaluator-artifact indeterminacy, not transition N

inference.N: same-state paired-effect repeat variance with separate arm self controls
inference.U_primary: Student t interval over independent trajectory estimates
